ITEM 1 | Glossy brown-orange glazed piece with darker sticky-looking coating and dark green herb flecks on top, irregular chunky shape about 6 cm long, sitting at upper right of the plate edge, slightly browned edges, sheen suggests sauce glaze | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow granular grains, loose and separate, slightly fluffy with small distinct kernels, spread in a loose mound about 6 cm across at center-left of plate, dry-looking surface | 70
ITEM 3 | Golden-orange cube-shaped piece about 4 cm across with browned, slightly caramelized surface and a dark green leaf tucked against one side, firm holding shape, dry matte surface | 60
ITEM 4 | Pale yellow-green leafy pieces, limp and wilted with translucent ruffled edges, mixed with a few small pale chunks, lying in a cluster about 8 cm across at lower right of plate, moist sheen | 45
ITEM 5 | Dark green crinkled leaves, wilted and glossy with slight oily sheen, forming a spread about 10 cm wide along the lower left and bottom of plate | 55
